prompt_context.title: Prompts and context templates
allowed: format and organization of tool feedback
prompt_context.evidence: Compare the actual instructions/context A received with its actions; identify an actionable ambiguity or omission.

visual_observation.title: Visual observation policy
visual_observation.evidence: Relate actions/edits, observation timestamps/state, image contents and actual model requests; distinguish absent evidence from absent observations.

history_memory.title: History and memory
allowed: retain, compress and retrieve execution evidence
associate memory with events and versions
history_memory.evidence: Show which relevant evidence was retained, lost or retrieved in actual A requests. Do not memorize task answers.

tool_orchestration.title: Tool wrapping and orchestration
tool_orchestration.evidence: Use tool calls, results and resulting environment state to identify the failure; preserve underlying capabilities and permissions.

retry_stop.title: Retry and stopping policy
allowed: allocate retries within fixed total budget
retry_stop.evidence: Locate repeated ineffective actions or premature stopping; predict cost as well as behavior. Never increase the outer budget.

internal_verification.title: Harness-internal verification
allowed: conditions for accepting completion within a rollout
internal_verification.evidence: Relate final edits, checks and remaining defects; internal checks do not replace official benchmark evaluation.

candidate_rule: One primary mechanism; supporting categories/files are allowed when they implement the same hypothesis. Explain each changed file in change_map.
fixed: official task inputs and dataset splits
process: One autonomous B session. Read and diagnose before editing as a prompt convention; the controller checks handoff artifacts and scope, not a seven-stage workflow.
